item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 09:15 PM 10 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Catanduanes(SanAndres), #Albay(CityOfLigao, Guinobatan, Camalig, Daraga, LegazpiCity), #Romblon(Magdiwang, Cajidiocan, SanFernando and Romblon) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Catanduanes(Viga, Caramoran), #Albay(Oas, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Bacacay, RapuRapu and SantoDomingo) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
